# Variation: default

The baseline behaviour of `skill-builder`: interview, generate the pair, refine through clean
sub-agent runs, gate, ship. Add one file per variation — each states when it applies and what
changes relative to this default.

| Aspect | Default |
|---|---|
| Applies when | no more specific variation in this folder matches |
| Adjustments | none — follow SKILL.md as written |

Known variation worth a file when it first occurs: building a **tool skill** (one that lives in
`.github/skills/`, like this one) — role-exempt, no pair, but everything else in the framework
still applies.
